citations.assessment: The witness names Huna Mar bar Avya answering Ashi’s concern about an appendage of the lung.
The different passage names Huna Mar bar Chiyya addressing Ashi about a channel between stomach compartments.
Rav Ashi names Huna bar Avya in his dream while replying to a challenge from Rav Avya.
The target repeats Ashi’s dream and attributes its clarification to Rashbam.

holds.reason: The two Chullin passages give different fathers in different cases.

notes.text: The witness names Huna Mar bar Avya answering Ashi’s concern about an appendage of the lung.
The different passage names Huna Mar bar Chiyya addressing Ashi about a channel between stomach compartments.
Rav Ashi names Huna bar Avya in his dream while replying to a challenge from Rav Avya.
The target repeats Ashi’s dream and attributes its clarification to Rashbam.
The two Chullin passages give different fathers in different cases. Their similar wording does not establish that one patronymic should replace the other.
